verdict: Amazon's sales rose 9% to $155.7B and profit jumped 64% to $17.1B as AWS grew 17% and earned $11.5B — almost two-thirds of the company's operating profit — though shifting exchange rates masked faster underlying growth.

otherDetail: Total non-operating income of $3,274M: $2,749M of other income, plus $1,066M of interest income less $541M of interest expense. Equity-method activity added another $1M after tax.

takeaways.title: AWS keeps carrying the profit
takeaways.text: AWS sales grew 17% to $29.3B and the unit earned $11.5B — almost two-thirds of Amazon's total operating income comes from the cloud.

takeaways.title: Profit grew seven times faster than sales
takeaways.text: Net income jumped 64% to $17.1B, helped by $2.7B of other income below the operating line, on top of a 20% rise in operating income.

takeaways.title: Currency masked faster growth
takeaways.text: Reported sales rose 9%, but shifting exchange rates cut $1.4B off the total — without that drag, sales would have grown 10%.
